theme: Skia m151 and managed perf work
highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 upgrades to Skia m151 and ports several hot paths to allocation-free managed C#.
highlights_body: This release lands a batch of managed performance work — color conversion, premultiplication, HarfBuzz shaping, and tag/color parsing all move off native round-trips or hidden allocations — plus new .NET 11 WASM assets and native resource-leak fixes.

bullets.detail: The bundled Skia engine is now built from chrome/m151, with several follow-up bug-fix syncs merged in during the preview cycle.
Adds prebuilt Emscripten 5.0.6 native libraries and a preview-.NET WASM test job so the WASM runtime tracks upcoming .NET 11 exception-handling changes.

bullets.lead: Native resource leak fixed in SKImage.FromEncodedData
bullets.detail: The overload that accepts an SKRectI subset no longer leaks a native resource when decoding fails.

bullets.lead: CPU raster regression fixed by restoring legacy shader context support
bullets.detail: Re-enables SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT to correct a CPU raster rendering regression introduced upstream.

bullets.lead: Several hot paths ported to managed C# for fewer allocations and less P/Invoke overhead
bullets.detail: SKColor↔SKColorF conversion, SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply, HarfBuzzSharp buffer/tag parsing, SKShaper glyph reads, and SKColor hex parsing now avoid native round-trips and per-call allocations, with no observable behaviour change.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: The Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM assets for .NET 11 and dropping an unused SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM redefinition from the Skia submodule

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the line with the Skia m151 update and the first managed performance ports (SKColor/SKColorF conversion and premultiplication math).
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added the Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM assets, HarfBuzzSharp and SKShaper performance work, and the CPU raster regression fix.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: Release Candidate 1 finished the WASM .NET 11 exception-handling test coverage and the native resource-leak fix in SKImage.FromEncodedData.

harfbuzz_summary: Ports Buffer.AddUtf8 and Tag.Parse to allocation-free managed implementations and refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1.
